units.NORMALIZED_CONTENT: All frozen-tree audit preregistration files remain preregistered protocols/criteria and are not compressed as outcomes. Exact members and blobs are resolved from the immutable tree.

All audit Python files are implementation/executor source. Presence of code does not establish execution or result; repairs/alternative implementations remain historically distinct source occurrences.

Frozen audit result JSON files are persisted source-reported results with file-specific scope. They do not become independent replications merely by appearing alongside audit summaries or consolidations.

Audit markdown files interpret bounded tests and preserve scope/controls. Audit prose is not a second execution of its underlying result and cannot retroactively alter an earlier frozen result JSON or preregistration.

Experiment-planning dependency consolidation is explicitly a dependency ledger, not a new theory layer or minimality certificate; its spine separates failure, closure insufficiency, extension synthesis, extension valuation, authorization and binding.

Source reports bounded experiment-planning results including reachable-refinement geometry, controller/STOP substitution, valuation/accessibility contractions, registry compression, supplied-extension basin opening, closure-insufficiency diagnosis and M0-relative extension synthesis, each with stated ceilings and surviving roles.

Extension synthesis is explicitly relative to externally supplied M0 and does not establish M0 discovery/minimality, extension valuation, authorization, binding or unrestricted research agency; extension valuation remains unresolved in the stated spine.

Source stores explicit workflow/artifact provenance for a DSLI R1 actual-application run, including workflow_run_id 31830476138, job 94864698925, execution branch/head and SHA/digest identities for executor, runtime, result and audit artifacts.

Actual-application result is explicitly POST_SPECIFICATION_APPLICATION_EVIDENCE; it records conformance 24576/24576 and invariance checks while anti-downstream flags deny candidate selection/ranking, authorization, binding, governance selection, v2 design update and language modification. Its internal `execution_performed=false` flag is preserved as source semantics and not overwritten by external provenance interpretation.

Post-v1 inventory freezes DSLI_R1 as CLOSED/STOP and keeps development evidence separate from target selection; candidates H1-H4 encode no ranking/priority and may motivate later design only after explicit selection.
Completed v1 archive is historical/immutable: post-v1 development material may not alter v1 meaning, scope, evidence class, language family, application result, terminal claim or scientific state.

H1 v2 surfaces preserve distinct stages such as preregistration, execution authorization, blocked precheck, implementation/repair and conformance records. Later pass/repair artifacts do not retroactively convert blocked or earlier states into successful historical executions.

DSLI R1 is represented as specification/preregistration, application-set freeze, reference/characterization/conformance, actual application, runtime, execution provenance, results, audit and terminal evidence ledger. Stage names are not collapsed; specification != application != execution provenance != terminal interpretation.

Extension candidate measurement/comparator/preference/scalar application families preserve separate preregistration, implementation, persisted result and audit surfaces. Similar `extension_candidate` tokens do not establish one formal object or warrant pooling.

Identification/architecture/synthesis audit families are distinct bounded questions. Results about comparison, preference, scalar sufficiency, measurement architecture or extension synthesis are not merged into a universal extension mechanism.

Minimality, granularity, repair-axis/substrate and ontology audits attack supplied structure at different levels; each source-local result remains bounded by its task family/contract and may not be generalized merely because later consolidation places them on one trajectory.

Accessibility, acquisition, valuation, refinement, closure and stopping audits preserve separate scientific objects and failure signatures; dimensional/result distinctions may not be collapsed into one future-sufficiency score.

Experiment surfaces for arena, latent aliasing, repair transfer, compositional repair, representation-language repair, operator invention, meta-language/meta-rule repair and related code preserve source-described experiment/protocol/implementation roles; source code alone is not execution evidence.

CUHK-X contains suite specification, preregistration, evidence ledger, adjudication, blocked execution precheck, matched-support characterization and manifest. These surfaces preserve blocked/unexecuted states and are methodological/external-validity evidence, not automatically a positive execution result.
Three correction-pressure cases are retained as source cases/examples for discriminating correction pressures; examples do not independently validate the general mechanism.

Repeated summaries, result JSONs, audits and checkpoints preserve provenance recurrence. Source occurrence multiplicity and document count do not establish warrant independence; independence remains NOT_ESTABLISHED absent separate generating provenance.

No GitHub workflow run was retrieved for frozen HEAD 2f4ca824...; this is not proof that audit code never ran historically because explicit source-local execution-provenance artifacts exist for some historical runs.
